cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)
project(robotarm_moveit_config)

find_package(ament_cmake REQUIRED)

# Same install layout as a package generated by the MoveIt Setup Assistant. MoveItConfigsBuilder
# looks for config/ and .setup_assistant in the installed share directory of this package.
install(
  DIRECTORY launch
  DESTINATION share/${PROJECT_NAME}
  PATTERN "setup_assistant.launch" EXCLUDE)

install(DIRECTORY config DESTINATION share/${PROJECT_NAME})
install(FILES .setup_assistant DESTINATION share/${PROJECT_NAME})

# Test/demo script, run with: ros2 run robotarm_moveit_config demo_motions.py
install(PROGRAMS scripts/demo_motions.py DESTINATION lib/${PROJECT_NAME})

ament_package()
